issues.reason: Run feat must be granted by linked feat catalog; Cat’s Luck requires decision-before-roll and daily use tracking; claw attacks, Acrobatics foliage exceptions, scent and fall reductions need manual application.

Both printed heritages change the base ability vector AND Natural Hunter skill trio; they must not stack with either replaced source. Variant Perform (Dance) specialization needs matching existing sheet field.
Class-page duplicates, caps, maneuver-specific bonuses and fractional accumulation must remain manual until class IDs and features verified.
Rule effects are mechanically paraphrased staging interpretations, not independently approved. No changes to live wizard or production manifest are authorized by structural validation.

Standard-trait testing only: identity, listed bonus languages, Natural Hunter, Fleet-Footed initiative and a manual Run card are supported. Cat’s Luck has a manually reset daily counter; reroll resolution is manual. Conditional AC, trip defense, falling and Sprinter remain manual; variants, alternates, favored rewards and independent review remain pending.

sectionInventory.reason: All printed standard mechanics from current official page transcribed to staging.
Every printed alternate trait represented, with manual target conflicts flagged.
All printed rows; no variant heritage table is present for Half-Breed.
All 39 printed entries retained as manual class-targeted rewards.
Separate feat catalog not a racial grant.
Separate archetype catalog excluded; bloodline eligibility not auto-applied.

features.name: Ability Score Adjustment
features.description: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma and -2 Wisdom.

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid with mithra subtype.

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium size, no inherent size adjustments.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: Land movement 30 feet.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Starts speaking Common and Mithran. With sufficient Intelligence, may learn Elvaan, Lupin, Goblin, Lalafellan, Orc or Vieran.

features.name: Cat’s Luck
features.description: Once daily, before attempting a Reflex saving throw, elect to roll twice and keep the superior result.

features.name: Lesser Defensive Training
features.description: +4 dodge AC against yagudo opponents.

features.name: Nimble Faller
features.description: After a damaging fall, always land upright; treat distance as 10 feet shorter for fall damage. +1 CMD against trip maneuvers.

features.name: Fleet-Footed
features.description: Gain Run as bonus feat and +2 racial initiative.

features.name: Natural Hunter
features.description: +2 racial bonus to Perception, Stealth and Survival.

features.name: Sprinter
features.description: +10 feet racial speed boost only while charging, running or withdrawing.

features.name: Low-Light Vision
features.description: Can see twice the normal hume distance under dim light.

features.name: Cat-Like Vision
features.description: Gain 60-foot darkvision; give up Cat’s Luck and low-light vision.

features.name: Cat’s Claws
features.description: Gain two primary claw natural attacks, each dealing 1d4; removes Natural Hunter.

features.name: Clever Cat
features.description: +2 racial Bluff, Diplomacy and Sense Motive; removes Natural Hunter.

features.name: Climber
features.description: Gain 20-foot climb speed and associated +8 racial Climb bonus; replaces Sprinter.

features.name: Curiosity
features.description: +4 racial Diplomacy to obtain information; history/local Knowledge always class skills, or +2 racial if already class skills. Replaces Natural Hunter.

features.name: Dexterous Tail
features.description: Tail can transport items, not wield weapons; retrieves small stored possessions as a swift action. Replaces Sprinter.

features.name: Jungle Stalker
features.description: +2 racial Acrobatics and ignore the first square of foliage difficult terrain each round. Replaces Cat’s Luck and Sprinter.

features.name: Miqo’te Heritage
features.description: Gain +4 dodge AC versus Ixal rather than Yagudo, by replacing Lesser Defensive Training.

features.name: Scent
features.description: Gain scent sensory ability, replacing low-light vision.

features.name: Keepers of the Moon heritage ability adjustments
features.description: Heritage ability adjustments: {'dex': 2, 'wis': 2, 'str': -2}. Apply instead of the standard racial ability adjustment, never in addition.

features.name: Keepers of the Moon heritage alternate ability
features.description: Substitute +2 racial bonus to Acrobatics, Stealth, Survival for the three Natural Hunter bonuses. All unaffected Mithra traits stay.

features.name: Seekers of the Sun heritage ability adjustments
features.description: Heritage ability adjustments: {'dex': 2, 'cha': 2, 'int': -2}. Apply instead of the standard racial ability adjustment, never in addition.

features.name: Seekers of the Sun heritage alternate ability
features.description: Substitute +2 racial bonus to Acrobatics, Perform (Dance), Survival for the three Natural Hunter bonuses. All unaffected Mithra traits stay.

choicePools.name: Mithra bonus languages
